subject.title: feat(gateway): session dashboard domain — board RPCs, ticketed widgets, dashboard tool, per-agent persistence

question: Should OpenClaw accept the session-dashboard server domain now as a core gateway, agent-tool, and per-agent SQLite contract, before the stated UI stitch PR lands?
rationale: This is a new cross-client persisted feature rather than a bounded regression repair; code review alone cannot decide whether the protocol, tool exposure, and upgrade model are the intended long-term product boundary.

options.title: Sponsor and complete the domain
options.body: Confirm the board contract as a core API, require focused upgrade and ticket-serving proof, then review the patch against the approved UI stitch plan.

options.title: Narrow the initial contract
options.body: Keep only the smallest internal storage or gateway seam needed for the already-approved UI integration and defer agent-tool or widget-serving API exposure.

options.title: Defer the feature program
options.body: Pause this PR until a maintainer-approved product plan defines the public protocol, persistence lifecycle, and release sequence.

recommendation.title: Sponsor and complete the domain
recommendation.body: Confirm the board contract as a core API, require focused upgrade and ticket-serving proof, then review the patch against the approved UI stitch plan.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the only evidence-backed author spanning the merged UI foundation and this proposed server-side implementation.
